letter_date.description: Date the letter was issued, normalised to ISO YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. '03-Jul-2025' -> '2025-07-03').

lender_name.description: The financing company / lender issuing the letter, e.g. 'Aditya Birla Capital Limited'.

cin.description: Corporate Identification Number (CIN) if printed, else null.

borrower_name.description: Full name of the borrower the letter is addressed to.

borrower_relation_name.description: Guardian/parent name if given as 'S/o', 'D/o', 'W/o'; else null.

borrower_address.description: Full mailing address as a single line.

borrower_phone.description: Borrower contact phone number; else null.

product.description: Loan product name, e.g. 'Point of Sale Financing', 'Personal Loan'.

sanctioned_amount.description: Sanctioned loan amount as a plain number; strip currency symbols/words and thousands separators (e.g. 'Rs 2,82,940.0' -> 282940.0).

disbursement_amount.description: Amount actually disbursed, as a plain number.

currency.description: Currency of the amounts; default INR for Rs/₹.

repayment_mechanism.description: How the loan is repaid, e.g. 'Equated Installment' (EMI).

emi_due_day.description: Day of month the EMI is due (1-31), from e.g. '5th of every month' -> 5.

interest_rate_pa.description: Annual interest rate as a percentage, numeric (e.g. '14.92 %pa' -> 14.92).

processing_fees.description: Processing fees incl. taxes, plain number (0 if nil).

facilitation_fees.description: Facilitation fees, plain number (0 if nil).

contains_pii.description: True if the document contains borrower PII (name, address, email, phone, account number).
